intro: The Cirrusfly Queen is a hunt targeting the matriarch of the aggressive insect hive dwelling in Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. Following early reconnaissance of the infestation, Elatrell Featherlight directs recruits into the heart of the grove to eliminate the queen and cull the swarm at its source. Ending her reign provides immediate relief to the local rangers working to keep the wilderness manageable.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.
Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.
Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Cirrusflies aren't to be underestimated. They might not seem dangerous, but you have to watch out for the bigger ones. The bigger they are, the meaner!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, friend. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.
